quality.reason: Well-structured digest with timestamps, engagement metrics, relevance scores, and source links shows solid curation infrastructure, but the individual signals are low-engagement news items (Coinbase criticism, a promotional USDC giveaway, reactive Trump/BTC sentiment commentary) that offer marginal trading actionability and border on general news noise.

Well-structured operational report with concrete metrics (fleet health, PnL, win rate, signal strength) and relevant filtered news, though the empty [[]] ticker tags and weak signal strength (0.44) slightly reduce actionability.

Well-structured performance review with genuinely actionable signals — the SOL NEGATIVE margin alert (assigned strategy not in top 10 while SOL-Trend leads at 77.63) flags a strategy misassignment needing reassignment, and score trend deltas (ETH 69.6→81.94) plus capital/position status provide clear decision-support value rather than noise.

Well-structured output with interpreted, actionable alerts (SOL 87% bid imbalance is a genuinely notable signal) atop a clean, timestamped table; minor deductions for near-zero funding rates and flat 1h moves that add little signal, and the truncated whale transaction.

Well-structured daily review with specific metrics, trend deltas, and clearly flagged problem agents (meta 45.8 ❌, paper_trader 51.2 ⚠️, arxiv 45.0 ⚠️) plus notable trading anomaly (no trades since May 22), though slightly truncated and some abbreviations lack context.
Well-structured digest with clearly relevant paper to the job's target domains, direct arXiv links, dates, and transparent methodology notes indicating verified abstracts rather than raw scraping.

Well-structured scan with specific probabilities, sentiment deltas (-3pp, +5pp) showing trend shifts, and actionable macro/crypto signals across Fed rates and major assets; minor deductions for truncation risk and no market links.

Contains one potentially real signal (fleet halted since May 2026, no trades in 3 months) but the output is unstructured mid-investigation monologue with filler phrases and no conclusion or action items, suggesting an incomplete or stuck agent run.
